why_no_new_terms: About fourteen English reports on the novel: every figure, world and Guardian they name has a page, and what they add — two rosters, English world names, the Guide's voice rules, the Assessment's diagnosis — are readings on those pages. The Foundation, Praetor and the reports' own apparatus (Contradictory Footnotes, a Found Footage Epilogue) stand in one report each or are borrowed (IIT, Whitehead, Popper, Specification Gaming).
